events.title: Lampshades FACE-TO-FACE Workshop Saturday 12 September 2026
events.location: Ministry of Handmade Studio, 11 Eclipse Street
events.description: Visit us and enjoy the Ministry of Handmade advantage! We use the same techniques that the professional lampshade makers use . . . no sewing, no glueing! Create your own professional standard drum or empire lampshade from scratch. Using fabric of your choice, make a new décor item that will be the hero of a room at your place or co-ordinate with existing furnishings. CHECK OUR LAMPSHADE INSPIRATION GALLERY Instructor: Julie Time: 3.5 hours Cost: $125 workshop fee includes your choice of one of the following lampshade sizes: Drum shades up to 30cm diameter Empire shades up to 28cm (bottom) diameter Optional extras: All extras (including fabric and art panels) are payable at the workshop. There is a small extra cost for larger sizes of shades: Drum shades up to 40cm diameter – $15 Drum shades up to 50cm diameter – $25 Empire shades up to 35cm diameter – $15 Empire shades up to 45cm diameter – $25 15cm/30cm rectangular shade – $10 20cm/40cm rectangular shade – $20 Hero Lamp – $89 Tower Lamp – $129 How much fabric do you need? CLICK HERE TO SEE FABRIC REQUIREMENTS Fabric selection: Light to medium weight cotton, linen, cotton drill, polyester cotton. Fabrics with very loose weave or coarse or uneven grain or texture are not really suitable. Fabric may be purchased from Ministry of Handmade. For empire shades, fabrics with designs that run obviously horizontally or vertically are not suitable as the shade curves. If you have any questions about this please contact Julie create@ministryofhandmade.com.au Provided: All other lampshade making equipment and tools for all lampshades. Lampshade kits: A variety of kits for Drum Shades, Empire Shades, Hero Lamps, Rocket Lamps and Rectangular Shades are available for purchase on the day so you can keep creating at home. Lamp bases: If you have a base in mind for the shade you are making, please bring the base with you so we can help you select the best size. Note: Please do not bring old lampshades for rejuvenating. It takes more time to restore an old shade than the time we have available at the workshop. Can’t make this workshop? If this workshop is full or the listed date is unsuitable for you, please check our newsletter for advanced notice of our next available workshop. SUBSCRIBE TO OUR NEWSLETTER > Payment Options > Cancellation Policy Buying your ticket Please enter a number (e.g. 1) into the ticket quantity field. You can use the “+” and “-” buttons if you wish. Then click the “Get Tickets” button. Ticket Button Help
